name: vintage-paper-runway-duo
image_vibe: Bold early-2000s-inspired glossy fashion with paper-print graphics, chrome accents, and vintage grain
image_purpose: Create a high-fashion duo portrait for editorial lookbook and campaign exploration.

prompt.project_info: A full-body dual-model studio fashion portrait with a clean white seamless backdrop and early-2000s-inspired editorial styling.
prompt.main_subject: Two original adult female fashion models in bold editorial poses: one kneeling with long platinum-pink straight hair, the other positioned closely behind with a short black wavy bob. Both wear designer-inspired printed fashion looks with matching printed over-the-knee boots, statement accessories, and small shoulder bags. Keep the styling fashion-editorial and avoid protected logos or exact brand designs.
prompt.composition_elements: Static full-body dual shot with a 50mm perspective, one model kneeling in front with attitude and the second seated or positioned close behind with one hand on her hip. Include large earrings, shoulder bags, and graphic paper-print patterns. Use a clean white seamless studio backdrop with soft shadows beneath the subjects.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Flat front-facing studio light with soft diffused fill and subtle contour shadows, high-gloss editorial finish, bold but controlled color, chrome and paper-print accents, and light early-2000s campaign-style film grain.
prompt.technical_specs: 50mm lens perspective, static studio setup, full-body composition, realistic skin, hair, printed fabric, leather, and accessory texture, light vintage fashion grain, high-resolution clarity, no readable logos, text, or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a full-body dual-model studio fashion portrait of two original adult female fashion models on a clean white seamless backdrop. One kneels in front with long platinum-pink straight hair and a bold editorial attitude; the other is positioned closely behind with a short black wavy bob and one hand on her hip. Dress them in designer-inspired printed fashion looks with matching graphic over-the-knee boots, large statement accessories, and small shoulder bags, using original non-branded paper-print patterns. Use a 50mm lens perspective, static high-fashion composition, flat front-facing studio light with soft diffused fill, subtle shadows beneath the subjects, realistic skin and material texture, high-gloss early-2000s-inspired editorial color, light vintage fashion grain, high-resolution clarity, and no readable logos, text, or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, sexualized pose, protected brand logos, readable text, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, malformed hands, plastic skin, over-saturated colors, watermark

assets.name: source vintage paper runway duo
assets.usage: Use only as optional guidance for the two-model arrangement, hair contrast, printed fashion styling, white studio, and vintage editorial grain; do not copy identity or protected branding.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve two original adult models, the front-kneeling/rear-positioned pose relationship, platinum-pink and short-black hair contrast, graphic printed fashion, white studio, and glossy vintage mood. Replace brand-like marks with original non-readable patterns.

changes: Reframed both models as adults and removed brand-specific styling/identifiable logos.
Retained the original duo composition, silhouettes, pose relationship, and editorial direction.
